scope: Complete source text and import scan of src, dashboard UI, scripts and tests. Pattern hits are a navigable dependency map, not a claim of exhaustive semantic proof.

adjudication.canonical: ActorRegistry and AssessmentCapabilities govern registry CLI/dashboard/native execution; private worker contexts and source-bound evidence share the same contract.
adjudication.legacy: Fixed slots, local three-actor onboarding and specialized identity/recovery engines retain v1 semantics. The registry cannot silently satisfy them. Ordinary eligible checks continue; explicit invalid mixed contracts reject.
adjudication.identity: Legacy NativeIdentityAdmission/ApplicationIdentity predicates are retained. New principal/role/tenant assurance is independent, complete-response bounded and execution/source bound.
adjudication.production: ProductionCampaign explicitly separates original v1 from registry v2, preserving exact origins, effects, reviewed workflows, budgets and expiry.
adjudication.browser: Actual Windows Edge HTTP cookie/form proof retained; exact late locale binding fixed without changing credential/header equality. HTTPS CONNECT and unsupported provider integration remain blocked.
adjudication.reporting: Report coverage is distinct from eligibility, manual outcomes and native proof. Bounded SQLite event records prevent the old event-size limit from hiding new coverage.
adjudication.remaining: No claim that every legacy engine has a v2 adapter, that regex review proves no latent assumptions, or that synthetic fixtures establish independent accuracy.
